marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 20 knots increasing to northwest 30 near noon
then diminishing to northwest 20 near midnight. Wind diminishing to light Sunday
morning then becoming south 15 Sunday evening. Scattered showers today tonight and Sunday morning. Fog
patches forming Sunday afternoon. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre building to 2 late this afternoon then subsiding to
1 or less Sunday afternoon.<br/>
